+async def pending_navigation_lease_observation() -> PendingNavigationLeaseObservation:
+    harness = await interactive_service_harness(InteractiveHarnessOptions(active=True))
+    snapshot = await harness.host.registry.get_session(harness.invocation.access)
+    if snapshot.page_signature is None:
+        raise TypeError("setup must retain a page signature")
+    run_id = harness.lease_request.run_id
+    thread_id = f"thread-{run_id}"
+    harness.manager.interrupt_records[run_id].clear()
+    context = NavigationInterruptContext(
+        run_id=run_id,
+        thread_id=thread_id,
+        phase="application_entry",
+        stage="target_ready",
+        reason="ambiguous",
+        checkpoint="application_entry",
+        generation=int(snapshot.generation),
+        page_signature=snapshot.page_signature,
+        takeover_available=True,
+    )
+    harness.manager.register_run(run_id, thread_id)
+    harness.manager.request_interrupt(
+        run_id,
+        "navigation:application_entry:ambiguous",
+        "navigation pause",
+        context.to_json(),
+    )
+
+    grant = await harness.service.create_interactive_lease(
+        harness.lease_request.model_copy(update={"checkpoint": "in_progress"}),
+        process_owner=OWNER,
+    )
+    retained = harness.host.retained_sessions[harness.invocation.access.run_id]
+    return PendingNavigationLeaseObservation(
+        grant_checkpoint=grant.session.checkpoint,
+        takeover_reservations=len(retained.takeover_reservations),
+    )
